QUOTE: "Always Allow/Deny" choices are persisted to the project YAML by `PermissionPersister`, and `add_permission` adds them at runtime.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that choices are persisted to the project YAML by a persister, separate from the runtime `add_permission` call. It doesn't name config.local.yaml, but it describes the same persistence mechanism.
